recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Peanut Butter Chocolate Bites

items.i: unsweetened apple purée / applesauce (about ½ cup)

steps: Mix the powdered peanut butter and applesauce into a dough.
Dip each ball in the melted chocolate with a fork and set on parchment.
Refrigerate about 10 minutes until the chocolate sets.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-bite macros come from the video description (makes 12; the original by @healthyu_dietitian makes 16 smaller ones). Tastes like Reese's balls. Check your chocolate if you need it vegan.
